claims.evidence: Witness photos show a dismantled car engine/transmission assembly with a circular bellhousing/cover plate, but no readable make/model (Ford Fusion) or brand/drive type is visible.
Photos do not show engine identification details (engine code, badge, or readable specs) to confirm cylinder count.
This is a request/statement, not something the photos confirm.

risks.risk: Wrong vehicle fitment / wrong gearbox-engine pairing (Ford Fusion claim not verifiable from photos).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox/engine identification label or stamping (part number/engine code) and a photo showing the exact bellhousing/gearbox model markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic dismantled engine/gearbox assembly with unknown compatibility (worst-case: may not fit or may require major swaps).

risks.risk: Not complete (missing key components like starter, alternator, sensors, wiring harness, turbo/AC parts, or mounting hardware).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo/clip showing all included parts (starter, alternator, sensors, wiring harness, hoses, mounting brackets, bolts) and a photo of the assembly fully assembled/complete.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete dismantled assembly (worst-case: missing essential working components).

risks.risk: Condition unknown / may be non-working (appears dismantled; no test evidence).
risks.proof: Video clip of a start-up test (or at minimum, gearbox engagement test) and photos of any leak points, compression/test results, or service records.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / likely non-working until proven.

risks.risk: Internal damage or fluid contamination (no evidence of compression, leaks, or internal wear).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the gearbox internals/gear teeth (where accessible), oil condition, and any visible damage; plus any diagnostic/test sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case internal wear/damage risk.

risks.risk: Engine type (petrol vs diesel) and capacity unknown; affects value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine code/label or VIN/registration-linked spec, or readable stamping on the engine block/gearbox.
risks.if_unproven: Price without knowing capacity/type (worst-case: lowest-value variant among possibilities).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of any engine/gearbox stamping or labels (part numbers/engine code) that identify Ford Fusion and the exact gearbox.

Send a photo/clip showing the assembly as complete (everything included) plus a checklist of included parts (starter, alternator, sensors, wiring harness, mounting brackets, hoses, turbo/AC components if applicable).
Provide a short video of a test: engine start-up (if possible) and gearbox gear engagement; or any diagnostic/test results sheet.
Confirm petrol vs diesel and engine capacity with a readable source (engine code or label).
response.reason: The witness can confirm it is a dismantled engine/transmission assembly, but the seller’s specific claims (Ford Fusion, drive/gearbox type, 4-cylinder, capacity) are not readable or verifiable from the photos. Without identification and completeness/test proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
